content: Web sources (Varnish/Cloudflare stale-if-error, TOCTOU bug reports): serving files rewritten by another process = read->validate->retry->fallback layering. Serve stale content ONLY as fallback for genuine read failure (stale-if-error), never as default first-request behavior. Stat-keyed cache entries (mtime+size) validate freshness; treat invalid cache as miss-not-error; validate every payload before serving. No single authoritative pattern doc - generic synthesis across cache/CDN sources.
